creator: Alexander Terp
description: The owner wants the door kept open (Lectern page muster-group-conversation, 2026-10-24): the conversation view placed in a tab beside terminal panes and arranged with them, rather than only shown in place of the panes. The view is drawn from a group, so the shell side is small; the open part is the daemon's tree, which would have to hold a pane with no terminal behind it, a protocol change. Not needed for the first version, which should not assume it cannot happen.
title: A group's conversation as a pane in a tab's tree
